description: We are Win Academy, an education coaching center based in Dadu. We are tackling the Earth System Trend Detective challenge alongside our talented students to represent our institute on a global stage. While our exact project is currently under wraps, our goal is to build a high-impact tech solution for climate data accessibility. We are looking for motivated members with skills in React/Next.js, API integration, UI/UX, or storytelling. Join us to build tech for the real world!
summary: Smallholder farmers in climate-vulnerable agricultural basins, such as District Dadu, Sindh, Pakistan, lose their entire crop yields due to invisible subterranean root desiccation, a phenomenon in which ambient air temperatures seem normal but root-zone moisture drops to deadly wilting levels days before leaves turn yellow. TerraSync functions as "Earth's True Detective" by integrating real-time natural hazard data from NASA EONET v3 and NASA POWER Agroclimatology (CERES & MERRA-2) into a Machine Learning Time-Series regression engine. With no hardware or ground sensor investment from farmers, TerraSync predicts the precise Countdown to Permanent Wilting Point ($t_{\text{PWP}}$) and sends out multilingual, life-saving advisories in English, Urdu, and Native Sindhi in automated HTML emails and synthesized voice audio.
details:
1. What does it do & how does it work?

Let’s rethink agriculture as a forensic science. TerraSync operates as "Earth's True Detective" for smallholder agriculture. It is an autonomous agroclimatic resilience platform that continuously scans farms using open satellite observations, hunting for invisible subterranean stress long before it manifests as visible, irreversible crop damage.

How we do it:

  • Data Ingestion: We built an engine that automatically pulls telemetry from the NASA POWER API—tracking root-zone wetness (GWETPROF), 2-meter air temperature (T2M), relative humidity (RH2M), and precipitation (PRECTOTCORR). We pair this with NASA EONET v3 to monitor real-time natural hazards.
  • Proximity Guard: To ensure our farmers aren't panicked by false alarms, our system evaluates planetary hazards within a strict 150 km geodesic boundary around the farm's exact coordinates.
  • Machine Learning Forensics: Our Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) time-series regression engine analyzes a 7-day rolling window of this telemetry. It calculates the daily desiccation velocity (dM/dt) to forecast the exact countdown to the crop's Permanent Wilting Point (t_PWP) for staples like rice, wheat, and cotton.
  • Vernacular Resolution: Data is only useful if it’s understood. Every morning at 06:00 AM PKT, our autonomous gateway dispatches localized, actionable alerts in native Sindhi (سنڌي), Urdu (اردو), and English. We also integrated the Web Speech API to provide 1-click audio read-alouds, completely bypassing digital literacy barriers.

2. What benefits and intended impact does it have?

TerraSync is designed to be immediate, accessible, and life-changing for farmers in high-risk climate zones like District Dadu, Sindh.

  • Zero Hardware Investment: Smallholder farmers don't need expensive IoT sensors, drones, or ground probes. TerraSync democratizes precision agriculture by running 100% on NASA Open Science data.
  • Massive Water Conservation: We help farmers pivot from blind flood irrigation to targeted evening and twilight pumping. This data-driven precision saves up to 30% to 40% of precious canal water.
  • Eradicating "Ghost Wilting": By catching the warning signs early, we protect regional food security and safeguard farmers' livelihoods from sudden, unforeseen crop failures.
  • True Universal Inclusion: By delivering insights in local mother tongues with phonetic audio guidance, we ensure that even farmers with no formal literacy can make proactive, data-driven decisions.

3. What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software were used?

To bridge the gap between orbital science and the soil, we stitched together a robust, modern, and open-source tech stack:

  • Frontend & Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and Lucide Icons for a blazing-fast, accessible UI.
  • GIS & Mapping: Leaflet GIS utilizing CARTO Voyager, Google Hybrid, and Satellite imagery layers to map fields with pinpoint accuracy.
  • Data & ML Forensics: NASA POWER REST API (leveraging CERES & MERRA-2 models) and the NASA EONET v3 API, which feed our Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) Linear Regression engine.
  • Backend & Delivery: Supabase (PostgreSQL) handles our database, while a Nodemailer SMTP Broadcast Gateway and the Web Speech API (Phonetic Voice Synthesis) ensure alerts reach the farmers seamlessly.

4. How is your project creative, and what factors did your team consider?

We didn't want to build just another generic weather dashboard. We approached the tragedy of crop failure as an orbital forensic case:

  • The Crime: Unexplained crop death despite completely normal surface temperature forecasts.
  • The Clue: The hidden decoupling between surface air temperature and root-zone moisture.
  • The Deduction: Using mathematics and NASA data to predict the exact soil wilting point days in advance.
  • The Resolution: Delivering actionable, localized canal management advice directly to the farmer in the language they speak at home.

Our Core Consideration: Empathy. We considered the stark reality that the farmers who need climate data the most are often the least equipped to access it. TerraSync bridges that gap. It translates the immense power of NASA's earth-observing satellites into a simple voice a farmer can trust, right in their pocket.
